#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [[ ! -d L0xRE-v0.1.6-linux-sm86 ]]; then
    if [[ ! -f L0xRE-v0.1.6-linux-sm86.tar.zst ]]; then
        curl -fsSL https://github.com/seanyourhighness/L0xRE-BeeLLama-Low/releases/download/l0xre-v0.1.6/L0xRE-v0.1.6-linux-sm86.tar.zst -o L0xRE-v0.1.6-linux-sm86.tar.zst
    fi
    printf '%s\n' '0d94b4e0729a26d761f1c6e59fb0dc088a657c6e67dcc0b09d03297ccb821adf  L0xRE-v0.1.6-linux-sm86.tar.zst' | sha256sum -c
    tar --zstd -xf L0xRE-v0.1.6-linux-sm86.tar.zst
fi
python3 L0xRE-v0.1.6-linux-sm86/architectures/sm86/launch.py \
    --profile sm86 --ctx 262144 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8187 \
    --model models/L0xRE-V2-27b-Low.gguf --draft models/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-Q4_K_M.gguf \
    --sparse-map models/qwen38-dlsa-d2048.l0xmap --mmproj models/mmproj-Qwen3.8-27B-Q5_K-MIX.gguf \
    --print-json -- -b 256 -ub 256 --reasoning on --reasoning-effort default --reasoning-format deepseek | python3 -c 'import json, os, sys
spec = json.load(sys.stdin)
argv = spec["argv"]
assert argv.count("--reasoning-budget") == 1
i = argv.index("--reasoning-budget")
assert argv[i + 1] == "0"
del argv[i:i + 2]
assert argv[-4:] == ["--reasoning-effort", "default", "--reasoning-format", "deepseek"]
assert argv[-6:-4] == ["--reasoning", "on"]
prefixes = ("L0XRE_", "ESCHA_", "GGML_", "LLAMA_", "LD_")
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(prefixes)}
os.execve(argv[0], argv, env | spec["env"])
'

about: With reasoning enabled and no output-length cap, the registry speed prompt can generate several thousand tokens and take substantially longer than the 30-second measurement window.
